instrument: Zoning text amendment, Data Center Opportunity Zone Overlay District (Sept 22, 2026)
summary: Overlay shrinks from about 9,700 to about 3,641 acres; new data centers outside it generally need a special use permit. A 90-day grace period applies; land with built or under-construction data centers or site plans past quality control stays in. Board chose 90 days over the Planning Commission's 120.

source.citation: InsideNoVa, WTOP, Virginia Business, Prince William Times, Sept 22-24, 2026

notes: Vote 8-0 after a mid-hearing closed session. Forward: setback proposal to Planning Commission in November, board targeted January. Grace period ends about Dec 21, 2026 (derived). Companion to va-prince-william-by-right-repeal.
